name: Engineers in Action
tagline: We design and build footbridges with communities that need them.
footerLine: Footbridges designed by UW students and built with the communities that use them.
purpose: Engineers in Action at UW is a student team that designs and builds pedestrian footbridges with rural communities that rivers cut off from schools, clinics, and markets. We spend the year designing, fundraising, and preparing, then travel to build the bridge alongside the community.
heroImageAlt: The EIA UW team on a finished footbridge

sponsorUses.title: materials
sponsorUses.text: Cable, steel, cement, and lumber make up most of what a footbridge costs.

sponsorUses.title: travel
sponsorUses.text: Flights, lodging, and transport get the student build team to the community and back.

sponsorUses.title: tools and safety
sponsorUses.text: Hand tools, harnesses, and site safety gear are bought for the build and reused on later trips.

sponsorBenefits: Your logo on this site and in our sponsorship materials.
A chance to recruit from a team of UW engineering students who have designed and built real infrastructure.
